This serializes requests and keeps the\nin-memory view consistent with the database between `save_storage` calls.\n\n### Persistence\n\nPersistence is implemented in `src/store.rs` by invoking the `sqlite3` command\nline tool. The schema is created by `init_db()` on startup if it does not exist.\n\nMutable state is saved with a simple “delete all, then re-insert all” strategy:\n`save_storage` deletes every row from `users`, `combat_sessions`, `combatants`,\nand `conditions`, then re-inserts the current contents of `SESSIONS` and\n`USERS`. This is intentionally simple and deterministic. The database is loaded\nonce at startup by `load_storage`.\n\nOther tables (`campaigns`, `characters`, `events`, `monsters`, `items`,\n`monster_tags`, `quests`, `quest_milestones`, `factions`, `npcs`,\n`campaign_inventory`, `character_equipment`, `crafting_projects`,\n`campaign_sessions`, `session_agenda`, `session_attendance`, `play_campaigns`,\n`play_campaign_members`, `play_narrations`, `play_campaign_documents`,\n`play_scenes`, `play_locations`, `play_location_connections`, `play_encounters`,\n`play_encounter_monsters`, `play_encounter_combatants`,\n`play_encounter_conditions`, `play_encounter_order`, `play_encounter_loot`) are\nwritten directly by their respective handlers and do not go through the\nin-memory caches. The storage reset endpoint preserves the `users` cache so\nthat authenticated play sessions remain identifiable across resets.\n\n### Startup migrations\n\n`init_db()` runs a set of small, additive migrations after creating the schema.\nEach migration checks the existing `PRAGMA table_info` output and adds missing\ncolumns with safe defaults. They are implemented through the shared helper\n`add_column_if_missing`, so adding a future migration is a single function call.\n\n### Request routing\n\n`src/main.rs` reads the request line, extracts the body, acquires both global\nlocks, and dispatches to the appropriate handler. After a handler that mutates `SESSIONS` or\n`USERS` succeeds, the dispatcher calls `save_storage` to persist the change.\n\n### JSON parsing\n\n`src/json.rs` provides a small, serde-free parser. pair.find('=') {\n            let k = &pair[..eq];\n            let v = &pair[eq + 1..];\n            if k == key {\n                return Some(percent_decode(v));\n            }\n        } else if pair == key {\n            return Some(String::new());\n        }\n    }\n    None\n}\n\n/// Percent-decode a simple URL-encoded value.\n///\n/// Only supports ASCII percent-encoded bytes and '+' mapped to space.\nfn percent_decode(s: &str) -> String {\n    let mut result = String::new();\n    let mut chars = s.chars().peekable();\n    while let Some(c) = chars.next() {\n        if c == '%' {\n            if let (Some(h1), Some(h2)) = (chars.next(), chars.next()) {\n                let hex = format!(\"{}{}\", h1, h2);\n                if let Ok(byte) = u8::from_str_radix(&hex, 16) {\n                    result.push(byte as char);\n                    continue;\n                }\n            }\n        } else if c == '+' {\n            result.push(' ');\n        } else {\n            result.push(c);\n        }\n    }\n    result\n}\n\n/// Dispatch GET requests.\nfn dispatch_get(\n    path: &str,\n    req: &str,\n    _sessions: &HashMap<String, CombatSession>,\n    users: enum PlayError {\n    BadRequest,\n    NotFound,\n    Conflict,\n    Forbidden,\n}\n\n/// Parse a non-empty id that follows a fixed prefix and ends with a suffix.\n///\n/// Returns `None` if the id is empty or contains an additional `/` segment.\nfn parse_play_suffix<'a>(path: &'a str, prefix: &'a str, suffix: &'a str) -> Option<&'a str> {\n    let rest = path.strip_prefix(prefix)?;\n    let id = rest.strip_suffix(suffix)?;\n    if id.is_empty() || id.contains('/') {\n        return None;\n    }\n    Some(id)\n}\n\n/// Parse a campaign id and a nested sub-resource id from a path.\n///\n/// The path shape is `/v1/play/campaigns/{campaign_id}{marker}{sub_id}{suffix}`.\n/// Both identifiers must be non-empty and must not contain additional segments\n/// before the marker or suffix.\nfn parse_play_nested<'a>(\n    path: &'a str,\n    prefix: &'a str,\n    marker: &'a str,\n    suffix: &'a str,\n) -> Option<(&'a str, &'a str)> {\n    let rest = path.strip_prefix(prefix)?;\n    let mid = rest.find(marker)?;\n    let campaign_id = &rest[..mid];\n    if campaign_id.is_empty() {\n        return None;\n    }\n    let after = &rest[mid + marker.len()..];\n    let sub_id = after.strip_suffix(suffix)?;\n    if sub_id.is_empty() {\n        return None;\n    }\n    Some((campaign_id, sub_id))\n}\n\n/// Parse a campaign id and encounter id from an encounter sub-resource path.\nfn parse_play_encounter_base<'a>(path: &'a str, suffix: &'a str) -> Option<(&'a str, &'a str)> {\n    parse_play_nested(path, \"/v1/play/campaigns/\", \"/encounters/\", suffix)\n}\n\n/// Parse a campaign id, encounter id, and a final resource id from an encounter\n/// resource path such as `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/encounters/{enc_id}/monsters/{m_id}`.\nfn parse_play_encounter_resource<'a>(\n    path: &'a str,\n    resource: &'a str,\n) -> Option<(&'a str, &'a str, &'a str)> {\n    let (campaign_id, after) = parse_play_nested(path, \"/v1/play/campaigns/\", \"/encounters/\", \"\")?;\n    let marker = format!(\"/{}/\", resource);\n    let mid = after.find(&marker)?;\n    let encounter_id = &after[..mid];\n    let resource_id = &after[mid + marker.len()..];\n    if encounter_id.is_empty() || resource_id.is_empty() {\n        return None;\n    }\n    Some((campaign_id, encounter_id, resource_id))\n}\n\n/// Parse a play campaign id from a path like `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/members`.\npub fn parse_play_campaign_path<'a>(path: &'a str, suffix: &'a str) -> Option<&'a str> {\n    parse_play_suffix(path, \"/v1/play/campaigns/\", suffix)\n}\n\n/// Parse a play campaign recipe collection path.\n///\n/// `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/recipes` returns the campaign id.\npub fn parse_play_recipe_collection_path<'a>(path: &'a str) -> Option<&'a str> {\n    parse_play_campaign_path(path, \"/recipes\")\n}\n\n/// Parse a play campaign recipe craft path.\n///\n/// `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/recipes/{recipe_id}/craft` returns\n/// `(campaign_id, recipe_id)`.\npub fn parse_play_recipe_craft_path<'a>(path: &'a str) -> Option<(&'a str, &'a str)> {\n    parse_play_nested(path, \"/v1/play/campaigns/\", \"/recipes/\", \"/craft\")\n}\n\n/// Parse a content tag update path.\n///\n/// `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/content/{content_id}/tags` returns\n/// `(campaign_id, content_id)`.\npub fn parse_play_content_tag_update_path<'a>(path: &'a str) -> Option<(&'a str, &'a str)> {\n    parse_play_nested(path, \"/v1/play/campaigns/\", \"/content/\", \"/tags\")\n}\n\n/// Create a new play campaign.\n///\n/// POST /v1/play/campaigns\n///\n/// The body must contain non-empty `id` and `name` and a positive\n/// `max_players`. The caller is responsible for authorization checks;\n/// `owner` is the authenticated DM username.\npub fn create_play_campaign(body: &str, owner: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    let id = extract_string(body, \"id\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let name = extract_string(body, \"name\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let max_players = extract_int(body, \"max_players\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if id.is_empty() || name.is_empty() || max_players < 1 || owner.is_empty() {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n    if play_campaign_exists(id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    play_campaign_create(id, name, owner, \"lobby\", max_players)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"id\":\"{}\",\"name\":\"{}\",\"owner\":\"{}\",\"status\":\"lobby\",\"max_players\":{}}}\"#,\n        escape_json(id),\n        escape_json(name),\n        escape_json(owner),\n        max_players\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Join a play campaign as an authenticated player.\n///\n/// POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/members\n///\n/// A player may own at most one membership per campaign, and character IDs\n/// must be unique within a campaign. The party must not already be full.\n/// Only players are allowed to join.\npub fn join_campaign(campaign_id: &str, body: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let character_id = extract_string(body, \"character_id\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let name = extract_string(body, \"name\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let class = extract_string(body, \"class\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if character_id.is_empty() || name.is_empty() || class.is_empty() || actor.is_empty() {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n\n    let max_players = play_campaign_max_players(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let member_count =\n        play_campaign_member_count(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if member_count >= max_players {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    if play_campaign_member_exists(campaign_id, actor).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    if play_campaign_character_id_exists(campaign_id, character_id)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?\n    {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n\n    play_campaign_member_create(campaign_id, actor, character_id, name, class)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"username\":\"{}\",\"character_id\":\"{}\",\"name\":\"{}\",\"class\":\"{}\"}}\"#,\n        escape_json(actor),\n        escape_json(character_id),\n        escape_json(name),\n        escape_json(class)\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Append a GM narration to a play campaign.\n///\n/// POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/narrations\n///\n/// The campaign owner or an active delegate with the `narrate` power may\n/// narrate. The sequence is append-only and starts at 1 for each campaign.\npub fn narrate_campaign(campaign_id: &str, body: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let (owner, _status) =\n        play_campaign_owner_status(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let is_owner = owner == actor;\n    let is_delegate = play_delegation_active_exists(campaign_id, actor)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if !is_owner && !is_delegate {\n        return Err(PlayError::Forbidden);\n    }\n    let text = extract_string(body, \"text\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if text.is_empty() || actor.is_empty() {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n    let sequence = play_narration_next_sequence(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_narration_create(campaign_id, sequence, \"narration\", actor, text)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"sequence\":{},\"kind\":\"narration\",\"actor\":\"{}\",\"text\":\"{}\"}}\"#,\n        sequence,\n        escape_json(actor),\n        escape_json(text)\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Start a play campaign.\n///\n/// POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/start\n///\n/// Only the owning DM may start a campaign. The campaign must be in the\n/// `lobby` status and have at least two party members. The first member by\n/// insertion order becomes the current actor at turn number 1.\npub fn start_campaign(campaign_id: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let (owner, status) =\n        play_campaign_owner_status(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if owner != actor {\n        return Err(PlayError::Forbidden);\n    }\n    if status != \"lobby\" {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    let members = play_campaign_members(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if members.len() < 2 {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    let current_actor = &members[0].0;\n    play_campaign_start(campaign_id, current_actor, \"player\", 1)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"id\":\"{}\",\"status\":\"active\",\"current_actor\":\"{}\",\"turn_number\":1}}\"#,\n        escape_json(campaign_id),\n        escape_json(current_actor)\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Read the caller's player turn context for a play campaign.\n///\n/// GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/my-turn\n///\n/// Only a campaign member with role `player` may read their own context.\n/// The response includes whether it is the caller's turn, the current actor,\n/// the caller's own character (id and name only), and recent public events.\n/// DM-private document fields are never exposed.\npub fn get_my_turn(campaign_id: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    if !play_campaign_member_exists(campaign_id, actor).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::Forbidden);\n    }\n    let (current_actor, _phase, _turn_number) =\n        play_campaign_get_turn(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let (character_id, character_name) =\n        play_campaign_member_character(campaign_id, actor).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let narrations = play_campaign_narrations(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n\n    let is_my_turn = current_actor == actor;\n    let mut events_json = Vec::new();\n    for (sequence, kind, event_actor, text) in narrations {\n        events_json.push(format!(\n            r#\"{{\"sequence\":{},\"kind\":\"{}\",\"actor\":\"{}\",\"text\":\"{}\"}}\"#,\n            sequence,\n            escape_json(&kind),\n            escape_json(&event_actor),\n            escape_json(&text)\n        ));\n    }\n\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"is_my_turn\":{},\"current_actor\":\"{}\",\"character\":{{\"id\":\"{}\",\"name\":\"{}\"}},\"recent_events\":[{}]}}\"#,\n        is_my_turn,\n        escape_json(&current_actor),\n        escape_json(&character_id),\n        escape_json(&character_name),\n        events_json.join(\",\")\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Read the GM turn status for a play campaign.\n///\n/// GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/gm/status\n///\n/// Only the campaign owner may read this endpoint. Players receive 403. The\n/// response includes whether the current actor is the owner\n/// (`needs_attention`), the current actor, a summary of all party members, and\n/// recent public narrations.\npub fn get_gm_status(campaign_id: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let (owner, _status) =\n        play_campaign_owner_status(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if owner != actor {\n        return Err(PlayError::Forbidden);\n    }\n    let (current_actor, _phase, _turn_number) =\n        play_campaign_get_turn(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let members = play_campaign_members(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let narrations = play_campaign_narrations(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n\n    let needs_attention = current_actor == owner;\n\n    let mut party_json = Vec::new();\n    for (username, character_id, name, class) in members {\n        party_json.push(format!(\n            r#\"{{\"username\":\"{}\",\"character_id\":\"{}\",\"name\":\"{}\",\"class\":\"{}\"}}\"#,\n            escape_json(&username),\n            escape_json(&character_id),\n            escape_json(&name),\n            escape_json(&class)\n        ));\n    }\n\n    let mut events_json = Vec::new();\n    for (sequence, kind, event_actor, text) in narrations {\n        events_json.push(format!(\n            r#\"{{\"sequence\":{},\"kind\":\"{}\",\"actor\":\"{}\",\"text\":\"{}\"}}\"#,\n            sequence,\n            escape_json(&kind),\n            escape_json(&event_actor),\n            escape_json(&text)\n        ));\n    }\n\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"needs_attention\":{},\"current_actor\":\"{}\",\"party\":[{}],\"recent_events\":[{}]}}\"#,\n        needs_attention,\n        escape_json(&current_actor),\n        party_json.join(\",\"),\n        events_json.join(\",\")\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Submit a player action for the active turn.\n///\n/// POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/actions\n///\n/// Only the currently active player may submit an action. The action is\n/// appended as a public event and the turn passes to the DM.\npub fn submit_action(campaign_id: &str, body: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    if !play_campaign_member_exists(campaign_id, actor).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    let (current_actor, _phase, turn_number) =\n        play_campaign_get_turn(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if current_actor != actor {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n\n    let action_type = extract_string(body, \"type\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let text = extract_string(body, \"text\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if action_type.is_empty() || text.is_empty() {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n\n    let sequence = play_narration_next_sequence(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_narration_create(campaign_id, sequence, \"action\", actor, text)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_campaign_update_turn(campaign_id, \"dm\", \"dm\", turn_number)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"sequence\":{},\"kind\":\"action\",\"actor\":\"{}\",\"type\":\"{}\",\"text\":\"{}\",\"next_actor\":\"dm\"}}\"#,\n        sequence,\n        escape_json(actor),\n        escape_json(action_type),\n        escape_json(text)\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Read the current turn for a play campaign.\n///\n/// GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/turn\n///\n/// Only the campaign owner or a member may read the turn. The response\n/// includes the campaign id, current actor, phase, turn number, and the\n/// deterministic turn queue (players in join order alternating with the DM).\npub fn get_turn(campaign_id: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let (owner, _status) =\n        play_campaign_owner_status(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if owner != actor\n        && !play_campaign_member_exists(campaign_id, actor).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?\n    {\n        return Err(PlayError::Forbidden);\n    }\n    let (current_actor, phase, turn_number) =\n        play_campaign_get_turn(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let members = play_campaign_members(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let mut queue = String::new();\n    for (i, (username, _, _, _)) in members.iter().enumerate() {\n        if i > 0 {\n            queue.push(',');\n        }\n        queue.push_str(&format!(r#\"\"{}\",\"dm\"\"#, escape_json(username)));\n    }\n    let logical_deadline = turn_number + 1;\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"campaign_id\":\"{}\",\"current_actor\":\"{}\",\"phase\":\"{}\",\"turn_number\":{},\"overdue\":false,\"logical_deadline\":{},\"queue\":[{}]}}\"#,\n        escape_json(campaign_id),\n        escape_json(&current_actor),\n        escape_json(&phase),\n        turn_number,\n        logical_deadline,\n        queue\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Nudge the current actor for a play campaign.\n///\n/// POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/turn/nudge\n///\n/// Only the campaign owner may send a nudge. The response includes\n/// both `story` and `dm_notes`.\npub fn update_document(campaign_id: &str, body: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let (owner, _status) =\n        play_campaign_owner_status(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if owner != actor {\n        return Err(PlayError::Forbidden);\n    }\n    let story = extract_string(body, \"story\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let dm_notes = extract_string(body, \"dm_notes\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_campaign_document_set(campaign_id, story, dm_notes).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"story\":\"{}\",\"dm_notes\":\"{}\"}}\"#,\n        escape_json(story),\n        escape_json(dm_notes)\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Read the durable role-filtered campaign document.\n///\n/// GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/document\n///\n/// The campaign owner receives both `story` and `dm_notes`. 'healthy'\"`. This is used by the startup\n/// migrations to make older schemas forward-compatible without altering\n/// behavior for newly created databases.\nfn add_column_if_missing(table: &str, column: &str, definition: &str) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let sql = format!(\"PRAGMA table_info({});\", table);\n    let output = sqlite_query(&sql)?;\n\n    let content = extract_top_array_content(&output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let has_column = extract_objects(content)\n        .into_iter()\n        .filter_map(|o| extract_string(o, \"name\"))\n        .any(|name| name == column);\n    if !has_column {\n        sqlite_exec(&format!(\"ALTER TABLE {} ADD COLUMN {};\", table, definition))?;\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Add missing death-save columns to an existing play_campaign_members table.\n///\n/// Older schemas created before the death-saves stage lack `status`,\n/// `death_saves_successes`, and `death_saves_failures`. extract_top_array_content(&sessions_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    for obj in extract_objects(sessions_content) {\n        let id = extract_string(obj, \"id\").ok_or(\"missing id\")?.to_string();\n        let round = extract_int(obj, \"round\").ok_or(\"missing round\")?;\n        let turn_index = extract_int(obj, \"turn_index\").ok_or(\"missing turn_index\")? as usize;\n\n        let c_sql = format!(\n            \"SELECT name, score, dex, position FROM combatants WHERE session_id = '{}' ORDER BY position;\",\n            sql_escape(&id)\n        );\n        let c_output = sqlite_query(&c_sql)?;\n        let c_content = extract_top_array_content(&c_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n        let mut order = Vec::new();\n        for c_obj in extract_objects(c_content) {\n            let name = extract_string(c_obj, \"name\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing combatant name\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let score = extract_int(c_obj, \"score\").ok_or(\"missing score\")?;\n            let dex = extract_int(c_obj, \"dex\").ok_or(\"missing dex\")?;\n            order.push(crate::domain::Combatant { name, score, dex });\n        }\n\n        let cond_sql = format!(\n            \"SELECT target, condition, remaining FROM conditions WHERE session_id = '{}';\",\n            sql_escape(&id)\n        );\n        let cond_output = sqlite_query(&cond_sql)?;\n        let cond_content = extract_top_array_content(&cond_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n        let mut conditions = std::collections::HashMap::new();\n        for cond_obj in extract_objects(cond_content) {\n            let target = extract_string(cond_obj, \"target\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing target\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let name = extract_string(cond_obj, \"condition\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing condition\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let remaining = extract_int(cond_obj, \"remaining\").ok_or(\"missing remaining\")?;\n            conditions\n                .entry(target)\n                .or_insert_with(Vec::new)\n                .push(crate::domain::Condition { name, remaining });\n        }\n\n        sessions.insert(\n            id.clone(),\n            CombatSession {\n                id,\n                round,\n                turn_index,\n                order,\n                conditions,\n            },\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Persist the entire in-memory state to SQLite.\n///\n/// This function is intentionally simple: it deletes all rows from the mutable\n/// tables and re-inserts them from the in-memory caches. The busy timeout\n/// helps prevent conflicts with rapid sequential requests.\npub fn save_storage(\n    sessions: &std::collections::HashMap<String, CombatSession>,\n    users: &std::collections::HashMap<String, User>,\n) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let mut sql = String::from(\n        \"PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000;\\nDELETE FROM conditions;\\nDELETE FROM combatants;\\nDELETE FROM combat_sessions;\\nDELETE FROM users;\\n\",\n    );\n\n    for user in users.values() {\n        sql.push_str(&format!(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (username, role, password_hash) VALUES ('{}', '{}', '{}');\\n\",\n            sql_escape(&user.username),\n            sql_escape(&user.role),\n            sql_escape(&user.password_hash)\n        ));\n    }\n\n    for session in sessions.values() {\n        sql.push_str(&format!(\n            \"INSERT INTO combat_sessions (id, round, turn_index) VALUES ('{}', {}, {});\\n\",\n            sql_escape(&session.id),\n            session.round,\n            session.turn_index\n        ));\n        for (position, c) in session.order.iter().enumerate() {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\n                \"INSERT INTO combatants (session_id, name, score, dex, position) VALUES ('{}', '{}', {}, {}, {});\\n\",\n                sql_escape(&session.id),\n                sql_escape(&c.name),\n                c.score,\n                c.dex,\n                position\n            ));\n        }\n        for (target, list) in &session.conditions {\n            for c in list {\n                sql.push_str(&format!(\n                    \"INSERT INTO conditions (session_id, target, condition, remaining) VALUES ('{}', '{}', '{}', {});\\n\",\n                    sql_escape(&session.id),\n                    sql_escape(target),\n                    sql_escape(&c.name),\n                    c.remaining\n                ));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    sqlite_exec(&sql)\n}\n\n/// Check whether a compendium slug already exists in the given table.\npub fn compendium_slug_exists(table: &str, slug: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {\n    let sql =
